ios.desc:
Introducing TrustCheck AI - a content verification app that makes authenticity checking and scam detection effortless and affordable. Simply upload any image, text, link, or screenshot and get instant authenticity analysis - no prompts, no technical knowledge, and no complex setup required. TrustCheck AI provides a cost-effective alternative to expensive verification services, delivering professional-grade analysis at a fraction of the cost.

Zero-Effort Verification:

Photo Analysis
Just upload any image. Automatically detects AI generation, synthetic media, manipulation, and editing without requiring you to specify what to look for.

Message Verification
Simply paste text from emails, SMS, or chats. Instantly identifies deceptive patterns, scam language, and fraud indicators without needing to explain context.

Link Safety Check
Drop in any URL. Automatically cross-references against threat databases and phishing networks - no security expertise required.

Screenshot Review
Upload screenshots from any app or platform. Automatically analyzes both visual and text elements for tampering or impersonation.

Built-in Intelligence - No Prompting Required:
Unlike complex AI tools that require specific prompts or technical knowledge, TrustCheck AI has all the expertise built-in. Just upload your content and get professional-grade analysis instantly. TrustCheck AI delivers the same results as expensive verification services at a fraction of the cost.

How It Works:
Paste or Upload your content
Get automatic analysis in under 30 seconds
Receive clear Low, Medium, or High risk ratings
Read simple explanations in plain language

Results Include:
Clear risk assessment (Low/Medium/High)
Plain-language explanations of findings
Actionable guidance for next steps

Privacy & Security:
No content is stored on our servers
Real-time analysis only
No account registration required
Optional local search history

Subscription & Pricing:
Try TrustCheck AI with 4 free scans to experience the full functionality. After using your free scans, continue with unlimited access for USD $3.99/month (300 scans per month - allow for currency conversion in your country/region). Subscription renews monthly unless cancelled. Cancel anytime through your Apple account settings.

quotes.text: After my family and I were scammed, I built this app to help tackle the $1 trillion global fraud problem. Available on both App Store and Google Play. I don't have a tech background and used AI to help me build it. The objective was to use AI to help catch AI being used by scammers. Check it out if you're interested.
